description: Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the payment itself as having processed it.

a.request: Considering only payments that link to a rental record, credit each payment to the staff member who processed the payment (`payment.staff_id`). For each such staff member, return the staff ID, the total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff members. Do not round anything.
a.sql:
SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(amount) / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total
FROM payment
WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY staff_id;

c.request: For payments that link to a rental, how much payment revenue does each staff member bring in? Show the staff ID, their total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff. No rounding. Each payment is credited to the staff member recorded on the payment itself as having processed it.
c.sql: SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS fraction_of_total FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id

b.request: For payments with a non-NULL rental_id, what is the total payment amount and its fraction of the total payment amount across all such payments, grouped by payment.staff_id?
b.sql: SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL) AS fraction_of_total FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id;

d.request: For payments linked to a rental, how much payment revenue does each staff member bring in, crediting each payment to the staff member recorded on the payment as having processed it? Show each staff ID, their total payment amount, and that amount as a fraction of the combined total across all staff, with no rounding.
d.sql: SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_payment_amount, SUM(amount) / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id;
